releaseNotes: Preserves the existing Firebase login/account and cloud-sync implementation; no Cloudflare dependency added.
Rebuilds all 80 legacy machine-formatted dialogues with new APS practice wording in simple, natural Standard Hindi instead of patching corrupted text.
Revalidates the remaining already-clean pilot and APS-original dialogues and applies the same meaning-first answer policy.
Uses चिकित्सक consistently for doctor in student-facing Hindi, with दंत चिकित्सक and पशु चिकित्सक where appropriate.
Adds multiple example alternatives and semantic policies so synonyms, natural paraphrases, grammar variation and active/passive equivalents can be accepted when meaning is preserved.
Rebuilds the Immunisation Enquiry and Dentist dialogues as higher-priority natural-Hindi examples.
Keeps Content Studio editing, missing-segment add/delete/reorder and import/export facilities.
Updates the service-worker cache so GitHub Pages does not keep the older V13 dialogue data.
Shows only APS-reviewed General Vocabs in the student UI; the raw PDF-reference entries remain preserved in data for future editorial review but cannot accidentally be studied as verified terms.
Removes the obsolete Pilot50 runtime overlay so older pilot content cannot silently overwrite the rebuilt V14 dialogue segments.
Expands offline synonym normalisation and adds explicit answer-flexibility metadata for paraphrases, word-order changes and active/passive equivalents.
